translations.source: With Tanzania as its central hub, Lake Gas supplies retail and bulk LPG across six countries. Its Tanzania network includes depot and filling locations in Dar es Salaam, Mwanza, Arusha, Dodoma, Morogoro, Iringa, Mbeya, Tanga and Zanzibar. Kenya operations have run since 2014.
translations.translation: Con Tanzania como centro principal, Lake Gas suministra GLP al por menor y a granel en seis países. Su red en Tanzania incluye depósitos y centros de llenado en Dar es Salaam, Mwanza, Arusha, Dodoma, Morogoro, Iringa, Mbeya, Tanga y Zanzíbar. Opera en Kenia desde 2014.
